FINAL FANTASY 7 GAME DIRECTOR COMMENTS ON THE FORTNITE COLLAB DISCUSSION

"As for a potential collaboration with Fortnite, there is nothing I can share that would raise expectations at this time. However, I can say that Fortnite was certainly one of the titles that provided inspiration for the creation of FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION."

(Spotted by @BackersGamesF)

RT @nhamaguc: As we approach the launch of FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION, we are exploring collaborations with a variety of different IPs. Our collaboration with Street Fighter is one of the first steps in that effort.
As for a potential collaboration with Fortnite, there is nothing I can share that would raise expectations at this time. However, as a game creator, I can say that Fortnite was certainly one of the titles that provided inspiration for the creation of FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION.
-

『FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION』のローンチに向けて、私たちはさまざまなIPとのコラボレーションを模索しています。ストリートファイターとのコラボは、その最初の取り組みの一つです。
フォートナイトとのコラボレーションについては、現時点で皆さんに期待していただけるようなお話はできません。ただ、ゲームクリエイターとして言えるのは、フォートナイトが『FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION』の創作に少なからずインスピレーションを与えてくれた作品であるということです。

FINAL FANTASY x FORTNITE IS LIKELY HAPPENING

FF7 Director Naoki Hamaguchi says they're currently considering several collaborations, and when asked if Fortnite is one of them, he said it's "something for the fans to look forward to"

He also called the Fortnite team "incredible and great partners to work with" and said Square Enix already has a relationship with them through the Kingdom Hearts collab

Hamaguchi also said "Barret" would be his pick for Fortnite, and revealed that FF7 Revelation's Highwind parachuting mechanic was directly inspired by Fortnite
